modelingNotes: Exact Murrelektronik article 85062, MCS 10-115-230/24 MIT PFC. Murr preserves the historical job manufacturer label. Primary product PDF and exact manual 85062_ina_4_14.pdf were visually reviewed; no successor or adjacent order is substituted.

Physical manufacturer numbers 1=PE, 2=N, 3=L, 4/5=DC−, 6/7=DC+ are established by the exact product circuit diagram and V1.4 manual front view. Product-PDF p.3 uses connector-local output indices 1,2=− and 3,4=+; these are not extra endpoints or the global 1–7 labels. No alias pins are added.

Only the fixed common output pairs 4–5 and 6–7 are established. They require explicit project jumpers; load/source/bus metadata does not join nets. No L–N, input–output, opposite-output-polarity, output–PE or PE–rail continuity is implied.

Input AC capability is 90–265 V, 50/60 Hz. DC capability conflicts across exact manufacturer documents: Product-PDF Version 2026-09-13 states 90–250 V DC; operating instructions V1.4 state 90–275 V DC operating range and 100–250 V DC nominal range; historical Catalog 4.5 p.9 states 125–300 V DC. The source input line instead says 24–28 V DC, which matches the output adjustment range and does not establish a low-voltage DC input. No combined DC range or DC-input polarity assignment is inferred; match hardware revision/instructions before DC operation.

Output is adjustable 24–28 V DC, nominal reference 24 V, with conditional total supply output current. Exact manual V1.4: 10 A continuous at 60 °C; 12 A at 40 °C with 110–240 V AC; DC cases at 60 °C are 8 A with 100–250 V DC and 10 A with 125–250 V DC. Historical catalog instead qualifies 12 A at 40 °C with 110–265 V AC; current product PDF lists 10 A and 12 A (UL) without combining those entries into these manual conditions. No per-terminal current or forced nominal-voltage scalar is encoded.

Partial interface coverage: exact manual V1.4 p.2 and current Product-PDF p.2 establish a front AUTORESTART ON/OFF removable jumper. The detailed pin identities and selectable continuity are not exposed, so this known configuration interface is documented but not rendered as invented terminals or a permanent fixed link. ON is factory pulsed restart; OFF shuts down on protection events. Installed setting is unknown; follow the manual for changing it.

Exact V1.4 manual front view identifies output adjustment, output-OK indicator and seven clamps; its numbered callouts are feature references, not additional terminal numbers. Historical exact catalog describes a green output-voltage LED. No output-OK relay terminal is documented. The manual requires a grounded mounting rail and classifies the supply as safety class 1; external PE and rail grounding remain project obligations, and this model does not prove a case-to-rail bond.

Required input terminals 2/3 and PE 1 represent the modeled supply use. Choice of repeated output clamps is application-dependent. Shared clamp policy supports explicit internal links plus field wires in the library; it does not authorize multiple conductors under a clamp. Exact V1.4 manual shows screw-terminal torque while the current sheet lists spring clamps: hardware/terminal construction must be checked against the installed revision.

Primary exact operating instructions: https://shop.murrelektronik.com/out/media/85062_ina_4_14.pdf, V1.4, English physical p.2 (German p.1); downloaded from the filename listed by the exact official article page. Historical manufacturer-authored Catalog 4.5 at https://www.hunglin.com/prodown.php?id=131, physical p.9 / printed 4.5.9, exact 85062 column. Conditional installation, parallel operation and derating rules remain in those sources.

connectionCoverage.notes: Seven documented power/PE clamps are modeled: 1 PE, 2 N, 3 L, 4/5 DC−, 6/7 DC+. Both common output pairs are retained. The exact front AUTORESTART jumper exists, but its individual pins and selectable continuity remain unmodeled; do not invent endpoints or treat its setting as a fixed link. The mounting rail must be grounded per the manual; additional physical bonding/contact geometry is not resolved by this model. No output-OK relay or communication interface is documented.
